description: Tailwind v3 defaults in use PLUS 7 bespoke min-width screens. The bespoke screens are all `min-<px>` named and are used for container/grid fine-tuning only.

loadBearingBreakpoints.768: THE structural breakpoint. Type line-height steps here (6 of 27 roles). The homepage pinned feature section (`feature.asset-swap-pinned`) becomes pinned here. Stats-grid left/right columns go flex-col -> flex-row. The /about numberedList flips flex-col-reverse.
loadBearingBreakpoints.1024: Container padding 20px -> 48px and max-width 1384px -> 1440px. Desktop nav appears / burger hides. Mega-menu becomes horizontal. Integrations panel flex-col -> flex-row and its dot nav appears. Footer link grid 2-col -> 3-col.

correctedClaims: CLONE_SPEC.md §3.3 and §6.5 both state the homepage pinned section pins at >=1024px. That is WRONG. The real source gates the pin on `window.matchMedia('(min-width: 768px)')` and records the measurement that settled it (pinned at 768 -> section 3976.56px; not pinned at 767 -> 1121.67px). The 1024 claim left the clone ~3072px short at 768.
